Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be fully reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The methodology is clearly described: building concept/token lenses from OV matrices, extracting word embeddings, computing parallelogram arithmetic, and evaluating nearest neighbor accuracy. The scripts (all_parallelograms.py, parallelograms.py, parallelogram_ranks.py) are well-documented and executable. Minor interpretation required to identify that plan results correspond to with_prefix condition.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment is reproducible with standard packages (nnsight, torch, matplotlib). Model (Llama-2-7b-hf) is publicly available. Pre-computed causal scores and data files are included in the repository. GPU memory constraints prevented fresh model loading during this specific replication session, but the environment setup itself is sound and well-specified.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results are deterministic: inference uses torch.no_grad(), no random sampling in evaluation, OV matrices are fixed model weights, nearest neighbor evaluation uses deterministic argmax. Cached results show consistent patterns across layers and head orderings. Effective rank analysis produces smooth, stable curves across rank values.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Repository provides full implementation code for running experiments, not a demo-only setup. The parallelogram_analysis.ipynb serves as an analysis notebook rather than a demonstration. Full replication is possible using the provided scripts.
